plan.name: Cool Mug Using Sink Basin
plan.strategy: Cool the mug by placing it in the sink basin with cold water, then put it in the coffeemachine.
steps: Find a mug in one of the cabinets, drawers, or on countertops.
Take the mug and place it in the sinkbasin with cold water.
Wait for the mug to cool sufficiently.
Remove the mug from the sinkbasin.
Place the cooled mug into the coffeemachine.
